name: Casting Fortify Timeline grants the Converge the Infinite buff (#1939)
contract: Converge the Infinite 520045's only effect is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) on the 520840 buff, and its tooltip is "Casting Fortify Timeline now grants you Converge the Infinite". Spell.dbc gives 520045 ProcFlags 0x0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned 0 - the buff could never be granted. Fortify Timeline is 804491 (SpellFamilyName 28, SpellFamilyFlags word1 4194304, DmgClass 1, effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL). With a spell_proc row keyed on that family mask at 100% chance, one Fortify Timeline cast must grant 520840. The caster's health is lowered first so the raid heal has real healing to do and Unit::ProcSkillsAndAuras sees a HealInfo.
